description: The Valuation Office Agency's annual Council Tax stock of properties statistics count every domestic property on the council tax valuation lists in England and Wales. The 2025 release, published on 25 September 2025 and last updated on 22 May 2026, counts 27.2 million properties at 31 March 2025, broken down by council tax band, property type (bungalow, flat or maisonette, terraced, semi-detached, detached, annexe, caravan and other), number of bedrooms and build period from before 1900 to the present. Tables CTSOP1.1, 3.1 and 4.1 give these counts for countries, regions, local authorities and down to middle and lower layer super output areas. Coverage: all domestic properties in England and Wales. Access: CSV and spreadsheet tables with a statistical commentary on GOV.UK, free. Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0. Caveats: build period and type come from VOA valuation records and are grouped into bands; small area counts are rounded, and Scotland and Northern Ireland are not covered. Simulation uses are small-area dwelling stock by age and type for building exposure, vulnerability and retrofit models. Related records: the England and Wales energy performance certificates and the INSPIRE Index Polygons.
